english.title: Damage site of special scientific interest without minimising the damage / restoring the site
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an authority to which Section 28G of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981 applied, namely **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), which conferred a duty to further the conservation and enhancement of a site of special scientific interest, namely **(..SPECIFY SITE..), without reasonable excuse carried out operations, namely **(..SPECIFY OPERATIONS..), which damaged the flora, fauna or geological or physiographical features of that site, by reason of which it was of special interest,

(A)_[without so doing in such a way as to give rise to as little damage as was reasonably practicable in all the circumstances to those features]_
(B)_[without restoring the site, so far as was reasonably practicable, to its former condition]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 28P(3) of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.

english.notes:
(i) See Section 28G(3) for a list of Section 28G authorities
(ii) See Section 28P(4) for "reasonable excuse".
(iii) As inserted by paragraph 1 of Schedule 9 to the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000.
(iv) Section 28P(10) of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981 provides that proceedings in England and Wales for an offence under Section 28P shall not, without the consent of the DPP, be taken by a person other than English Nature or the Natural Resources Body for Wales.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Difrodi safle o ddiddordeb gwyddonol arbennig heb leihau'r difrod / adfer y safle
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), a chithau'n awdurdod y mae Adran 28G Deddf Bywyd Gwyllt a Chefn Gwlad 1981 yn berthnasol iddo, sef **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), a oedd gan ddyletswydd i warchod a mwyhau ymhellach safle o ddiddordeb gwyddonol arbennig, sef **(..SPECIFY SITE..), heb esgus rhesymol, bu i chi gyflawni gweithredoedd, sef **(..SPECIFY OPERATIONS..), a achosodd ddifrod i blanhigion, anifeiliaid, neu nodweddion daearegol neu ffisiograffigol i'r safle hwnnw, drwy reswm sef ei fod o ddiddordeb arbennig,

(A)_[heb wneud hynny mewn modd sydd wedi peri cyn lleied o ddifrod a oedd yn ymarferol rhesymol yn yr holl amgylchiadau i'r nodweddion hynny]_
(B)_[heb adfer y safle, cyn belled ag yr oedd yn ymarferol rhesymol, i'w gyflwr blaenorol]_
